_help: Cosmetic extras bought with coins. Coins are site points with no cash value: they can never be withdrawn, sold or swapped for money, crypto or tokens. They unlock these extras and the paid items that have a coin price in data/products.json. Ids and coin prices must match the cosmetic_items list in supabase/003_progress.sql (the database checks the price). slot: cert (certificate style), frame (badge frame around your picture), theme (My Progress colours).
noCash: Coins are site points. They unlock extras and paid items on web3.toys, but have no cash value and can never be withdrawn, sold or swapped for money, crypto or tokens.
